description: Controller record, after the run failed once a Step that writes to GitHub was dispatched, through its closing, of what exists as read-only reads showed it once that Step's session was closed: the session, the worktree and its branch on GitHub with that branch's pull requests, and the receipt of that Step's last contract with what GitHub shows for it. Which Step it was is step. Nothing was judged; no pull request was closed, no branch deleted and nothing undone

status.description: present or absent as GitHub showed it; unknown when it was not read, or the read failed, see detail

failure.description: The error the run fails with

step.description: The Step that writes to GitHub after whose dispatch the run failed. publish: the correction Step that opened the pull request; its contract reports the branch, head and pull request. fix: the fix Step after the deep review; its contract reports only the head, and the branch and pull request are the pull request record's. converge: the converge Step of the convergence round that the round-NNN- prefix of this record's output name names; it reports like fix. cleanup: the cleanup Step after the convergence rounds; it reports like fix

exit_confirmed.description: Whether the session of step was confirmed closed before the reads; when false the Agent may have written after them

status.description: read: head and branch were read through the worktree registration. unknown: a read failed, see detail

branch.description: The branch the worktree HEAD is on; empty when it is detached

remote_branch.description: The worktree branch in the target repository on GitHub; unknown without detail when the worktree has no branch to look up, see worktree

pull_requests.description: Pull requests in any state whose head is the worktree branch of the target repository, one page of at most 100; unknown without detail when the worktree has no branch to look up, see worktree

status.description: listed: items is what GitHub listed. unknown: the list was not read, or the read failed, see detail, and items is empty

reported.description: The receipt of the last contract of step that passed the schema, accepted or rejected, which is the output named after step, for converge with the round-NNN- prefix of this record's output name, with its branch and pull request as step says where they come from, and what one read each shows for that branch and pull request number in the target repository on GitHub. A branch pushed under another name than the worktree branch is covered only here

observed_pull_request.description: The pull request with the reported number in the target repository

status.description: read: item is what GitHub showed. unknown: the read failed or its answer could not be read, see detail
